plain_english: The client can transfer this contract to any of its related companies or a successor without asking you, but you cannot transfer the contract to anyone else unless the client gives you written permission.
what_it_means_for_you: You may be forced to work for a different company if the client assigns the agreement, and you cannot change who you work for without the client’s consent.
risk_reasons: The clause lets the client assign the agreement freely, which could place you under a new party you didn’t choose.
Your ability to assign the contract is restricted, creating an imbalance of rights between the parties.
questions_to_ask: Will the client notify me in writing before assigning the agreement to an affiliate or successor?
If the agreement is assigned, will the payment terms and obligations remain the same?
Can I request the new party’s details and any changes to the scope of work?
What happens if I need to assign my rights to a subcontractor—do I need the client’s consent each time?
evidence_quote: The Client may assign this Agreement to any affiliate or successor. The Freelancer may not assign this Agreement without the Client's written consent.
